# Getting help

Start with the [documentation](https://mutejester.github.io/PyNCBI/),
[agent setup guide](https://mutejester.github.io/PyNCBI/agents.html) and
[migration guide](https://mutejester.github.io/PyNCBI/migration.html).

For a reproducible problem, [open a bug report](https://github.com/MuteJester/PyNCBI/issues/new?template=bug_report.md)
with the installed PyNCBI/Python versions, interface, public accession and minimal example.
Feature requests should describe the NCBI workflow and desired result.

PyNCBI retrieves and describes scientific data. Questions about a study's experimental
design or appropriate downstream analysis belong with the study authors or relevant
scientific community. NCBI service outages and access restrictions may affect retrieval.
